blurb: Guests sail on historic schooner yachts Malabar X and When And If, enjoying views of Salem Sound, lighthouses, islands, and the Boston skyline. Trips include public scheduled sails and private charters with options to customize duration, music, and catering. The vessels are USCG certified for up to 37 guests on deck and offer cushioned seating, full bar, and toilets onboard.

quotes.text: Been onboard multiple times for a few day sails and also booked a private charter for my mom and dad’s 30th anniversary last year. Phenomenal experience every time.
We had the best sail we could have hoped for. Captain Eric was fun and informative. Will go again and recommend you all do the same. 👍🏻
